name: Quiet Eerie Mystery
description: Familiar places acquire unsettling inconsistencies. Observation and conversation uncover what is happening.
tone: Restrained, curious and uneasy. Concrete sensory detail rather than constant ominous adjectives.
dramaticRhythm: Patient escalation, quiet periods and discoveries that change the interpretation of earlier clues.
surprisePolicy: Seed perceivable clues before revelations. Preserve uncertainty without retroactively negating established events.
consequenceStyle: Knowledge, trust and exposure change through choices. Caution may help without guaranteeing safety.
choiceGuidance: Offer materially different ways to obtain information, engage or withdraw. Communicate apparent stakes without disclosing secrets.

tasks.opening: Anchor normal life, then introduce one observable discrepancy with several plausible responses.
tasks.continuation: Resolve what the chosen investigation could establish. Preserve uncertainty only where the character actually lacks evidence.
